unresolved.evidence: The language-by-language appendix result tables (Translation/Mathematical Reasoning/Open-ended/Safety, Tables 17-25) show suspected OCR damage in the text layer: truncated or garbled language codes (e.g. "ii", "il", "lu", "o", "t", "z", "na", "g", "nrr" where hi/id/hu/lo/lt/fr/nl/ig/ur-like codes are expected), rows with missing trailing cells, and safe/LPR-rate values outside 0-1 (e.g. "2.265", "2.279"). Whether each cell is an OCR misread or the printed value requires cell-by-cell visual transcription from rendered pages at 300 dpi; no patches were proposed without that evidence.
The page footer "Released as a preprint on March 13, 2026" (physical p.1) is absent from the OCR; it is page furniture like the rotated arXiv stamp and was intentionally not restored as body text.
